text:
lisa: Quick heads-up — last-minute $5 parlay for tonight's games? winner takes the pot, plus we're raffling a spare Raptors jersey in the breakroom. who wants in? :moneybag: :jersey:
omar: I'm in. small stakes, big drama. which games are we using?
jen: count me in for the raffle too. i'll donate a pizza if i win (jk). :pizza:
sahil: i'll take the underdog parlay. always the risk taker. who picks the legs?
lisa: going to put 3 legs — Nets @ Hawks (Hawks +7), Spurs ML, and Wolves over 220. feel free to counter-propose.
mark: Hawks +7? bold. i'm tempted to take Nets ML instead. also, raffle ticket = 1 entry per $5 buy-in?
lisa: yep one entry per person + an extra ticket if you bring snacks to the watch in conference B.
omar: Snacks = chips & guac from me. i'll be there. :chipmunk:
jen: i'll bring a cheesecake (don't @ me, it's dessert and it's for the team). :cheesecake:
sahil: can we do a quick poll for snacks so we don't duplicate? opsbot can we?
opsbot: Poll created by sahil: "Who will bring snacks?" Options: 1) Omar - chips & guac 2) Jen - cheesecake 3) Mark - wings 4) Lisa - pretzel bites. React with :one:, :two:, :three:, :four:.
mark: reacting now. :three:
omar: :one: done
jen: :two: (i will bring tongs)
lisa: haha tongs noted. also planning to stream in conf-B at 7:30 — projector + surge strip ready. anyone need HDMI?
sahil: i have an HDMI-C to USB-C adapter, i'll bring it.
omar: bringing the power strip + my portable speaker. low-volume hype, promise. :speaker: :thumbsup:
opsbot: Poll closed. Results: 1) Omar - 5 votes, 2) Jen - 3 votes, 3) Mark - 2 votes, 4) Lisa - 1 vote. Winner: Omar (chips & guac).
jen: congrats raffle-wise to whoever wins the jersey. also reminder: $5 collection in cash before the first game. i'll Venmo if someone collects.
mark: can someone make a tiny google sheet for picks so we don't argue winners later? short table: name / picks / amount paid.
lisa: doing it now — link: https://tiny.redwood/ramble-parlay (put your picks there).
omar: done. placed my Hawks +7 pick. :crossed_fingers:
sahil: placed underdog combo. may the worst odds be ever in my favor. :pray:
jen: added. cheesecake reserved. if i win i'll donate to the snack fund too. :trophy:
lisa: perfect — see y'all at 7:15 if you want to set up. chaotic vibes encouraged. :popcorn:
